Casper Delacroix (Head of HR): Thank you. I shall be direct, as I would wish you to be. We have decided to proceed with Tallyhold.

Casper Delacroix (Head of HR): It was our benefits broker. We have relied upon her for many years. She handles our renewals, our carrier negotiations, our open enrollment each autumn. When she learned we were assessing payroll and HR platforms, she sent a proposal for a bundle, with Tallyhold as the platform. That is the bundle she put in front of us. I attended the demonstration, which came, I recall, nearly four weeks after our first conversation, and I found it thorough. Casper Delacroix (Head of HR): The recommendation came from someone we trust. That is the whole of it.

Nadia Jessamy (General Manager): Thank you. It was a pleasure.

Sunniva Galbraith (HR Director): I'm going to be honest with you, I haven't slept well since the demo. Not because of you. Because of what I couldn't answer for my own people.

Sunniva Galbraith (HR Director): Twelve states. That's our reality, because we've got remote staff scattered everywhere. Signe Hollander (People Operations Lead): No. The demo scored well on our internal rubric, I think we gave it a thirty-four out of forty. Pricing was in range. The eleven states, that's a complication for any vendor, we knew that going in, but it didn't stop us.
